recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Do not change the active value set back to 422096002 for FHIR-5990; any future cleanup of unused duplicate value-set files should be handled separately.
issue_request: FHIR-5990 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for DSTU1 medication resources. It reported that the administration-method value-set expansion looked like procedure types rather than medication administration methods/routes, and the accepted resolution was to fix the link to the correct value set and add SNOMED CT 422096002 Dosing instruction fragment as an exemplar value set.
initial_application: Commit adf4e89f89fd36602f6b6e7520c1025949477424 explicitly included GF#7742 and GF#5990 and added administration-method exemplar value set bindings, including 422096002 value set content.
additional_context: FHIR-7742 is the parallel MedicationAdministration issue from the same value-set correction family. The current model has since been refactored, and the administration-method value set is used by active MedicationAdministration.dosage.method and Dosage.method source. Later Published issue FHIR-19913 changed the active value set basis from 422096002 to SNOMED CT 736665006; that later issue is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. FHIR-5990 was applied historically, the current active administration-method value set is correct after FHIR-19913, and the remaining source/medicationrequest copy with 422096002 is an unreferenced historical duplicate rather than the active current binding source.
